author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
So, Legoche mentioned that the mapdevs need more of the KoTH/5CP/3CP maps for Atlas.

Then xXBatManXx had the bright idea of converting Chimeric III (a map I built in collaboration with him) into just a KoTH. Since Chimeric III was a KoTH and DTC, that could be done simply by removing the cores. I personally thought that would be a bit boring, and instead we agreed to replace the cores with additional capture points and make it 3CP.

So here you go.



The world files and XML are here: https://www.dropbox.com/s/22saggeslxfclxh/Chimeric%20III%203CP%20Solo.zip?dl=0

A picture album is here: http://imgur.com/a/mozjH

Team sizes are a maximum of 20 vs 20.

Once a team captures the center hill, they spawn right by it until they lose the hill.

You can only capture the other team's hill if you own the central hill.

The max build height is 27 (bedrock is 0).

The spawn kit can be viewed here: http://pastebin.com/gSgPDW00

The XML is probably not completely functional since it is the first one I have made for Atlas.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Played this map in OCN's map test server... Plays really well and is super fun actually :D

Anyway, @Distraction I'll debug the XML when I have the time. It also saves time if you paste the XML in an anonymous pastebin such as Hastebin.

People can only view it if you send links.

Also, the way that the spawn kit is modelled is incorrect, go to maps.avicus.net then go to ATLAS to see how you model our way of doing the spawnkit and everything else.

How is it a bit stranger?

They won't be allowed to build/break anywhere near the capture points, they'll mainly be using blocks to bridge over to one another's side.

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body:
The full XML I have made is here: http://hastebin.com/uvupuwugeh.xml
I will admit that there are a few things that I was not able to find how to do in the Atlas documentation, so I left them out. These include:
  • Taking away Resistance 10 from the player once they exit their own side's iron bars.
  • Making it so that a team spawns at the center once they own the center hill (although the spawns for that are defined).
  • And probably something else that I may have forgotten.
